clues: This town in south Sumatra lies at the foot of Mount Dempo, a high volcano. A long chain of green peaks runs past its west side.
High land lifts this town up where the air stays cool. Most towns down low in south Sumatra feel much more heat.
This town split off to stand on its own in the year two thousand and one. It had been part of a big county near by.
West of this town looms the top peak in all of south Sumatra. It is a tall volcano that towers high in the sky.
Guests come from far towns to see the grand green views here. Cool air and fine sights make it a much loved trip spot.
